title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Investors to focus on March employment, retail sales, Powell’s speech amid ongoing Mideast war | Stock Market News
summary: Investors anticipate a busy week of economic data releases and geopolitical tensions in West Asia, with key indicators including consumer confidence, retail sales, job openings, and manufacturing reports. Major companies are also set to release quarterly earnings reports amidst volatile energy markets and stock market declines.
sentiment_reason: The focus on economic data and geopolitical tensions, coupled with the recent worst week for US stock indices since the Iran war began, indicates negative market sentiment.
